title: Confirm the Auto-Approve Path
scenario: It is 1:30 PM. Only INV-59001 cleared every check, so it takes the auto-approve path - the quiet lane where a fully clean invoice moves toward payment without a human touching it. Confirm it belongs there and that the path logs the approval it grants.
input: INV-59001 (V-1042 Northwind Fasteners): not a duplicate, variance $0 within a $25 band, quantity 500 of 500 received, vendor on file with ACH ...4021. It is the only invoice of the five that is clean on every check.
instructions: Confirm INV-59001 meets every condition for straight-through approval.
Understand what the auto-approve path records and what it does not decide.
Answer the questions and validate to mint the auto-approval log.

questions.prompt: Why does INV-59001 qualify for auto-approve when the other four do not?

options.text: It is the largest invoice in the batch
It is clean on every check: not a duplicate, within tolerance, quantity matched, vendor on file
It arrived first in the inbox

questions.explain: Auto-approve is earned by passing every gate, not by size or order. INV-59001 is the only invoice with no duplicate flag, price within band, quantity confirmed, and a governed vendor.

options.text: The invoice is paid instantly with no further steps
It moves toward payment without manual review, but still enters the batch and awaits the run approval
A manager signs each auto-approved invoice by hand

questions.explain: Straight-through means no human works the invoice, not that controls vanish. INV-59001 still joins the payment batch and waits for the single run approval before money moves.

questions.prompt: What does the auto-approve path record for INV-59001?

options.text: Nothing - clean invoices need no log
An approval entry noting it passed all checks, so the decision is auditable

questions.explain: Even the quiet path is logged. Recording that INV-59001 passed every check keeps the auto-approval auditable - you can always show why it skipped manual review.

questions.prompt: If a fifth check later flagged INV-59001, what should happen?

options.text: Keep it on the auto-approve path since it started clean
Pull it to the exception queue - auto-approve requires every check to stay clean

questions.explain: The auto-approve path is conditional on being clean on all checks. Any new flag moves the invoice to exceptions; the quiet lane is only for invoices that pass every gate.

copilotPrompt: Confirm INV-59001 qualifies for straight-through auto-approval: it is not a duplicate, within tolerance, quantity-matched, and its vendor is on file. Explain that it still enters the batch and awaits run approval, and that the approval is logged.
successMessage: Auto-approve confirmed. INV-59001 passed every check and is logged into the payment batch, awaiting the run approval.

intro.heading: The quiet lane: earned, not skipped

sections.title: One invoice earned the quiet path
sections.body: Of five invoices, only INV-59001 passed every gate. Auto-approve is a reward for being clean on all checks, not a shortcut - the other four are working through exceptions right now.

sections.title: Straight-through, not control-free
sections.body: Auto-approve means no human reviews the invoice line by line, but it still enters the payment batch and waits for the single run approval before any money moves. Controls stay; only the manual touch is removed.

sections.title: The quiet path is still logged
sections.body: The approval is recorded with the checks it passed, so you can always show why INV-59001 skipped manual review. And if any new flag appears, it is pulled to exceptions - clean is a continuing condition.

takeaway.heading: Auto-approve path confirmed
points: INV-59001 was the only invoice clean on every check, so it earned the auto-approve path.
Straight-through means no manual review, but it still enters the batch and awaits the run approval.
The approval is logged with the checks it passed, keeping the quiet path auditable.
Any new flag would pull it back to exceptions - auto-approve requires staying clean on all checks.
The workflow can now move a fully clean invoice toward payment without manual handling while keeping the record.
